snapshot_policy.time: immediately after registration and before the first review wave
snapshot_policy.working_tree: review the live working-tree bytes, including tracked modifications and untracked files inside the declared selectors
snapshot_policy.manifest: materialize corpus-manifest.json in the review folder with every selected path, byte size, SHA-256 digest, Git status, selector owner, and an aggregate path-sorted digest
snapshot_policy.drift: block synthesis if any selected byte changes after the manifest freeze; a new freeze requires rerunning all attackers
snapshot_policy.authority: the manifest identifies evidence bytes but grants no semantic, implementation, promotion, or release authority

dependency_closure.policy: include every repository-owned component path, contract, fixture, and tool named by a selected provider or package script, even when it resides elsewhere under projects/domainspec-v2/impl

derived_selectors.reason: package dependency lock adjacent to selected package.json

aggregate.algorithm: sha256(path + NUL + file_sha256 + NUL + decimal_byte_size + LF), path-sorted

selector_census.selection_kind: dependency-closure:package dependency lock adjacent to selected package.json

exclusion_census.pattern: public Arcanum files and all repositories outside domainspec-core

selection_residue.note: The literal confirmed exclusions contain **/target/** but not **/cargo-target/**. Therefore redirected Rust build-cache bytes under declared remaining-meta-types/** selectors remain in the frozen corpus; no unconfirmed exclusion was added.

selection_kinds: dependency-closure:package dependency lock adjacent to selected package.json

claim_ceiling: This target packet authorizes only a read-only review proposal. Even a fully accepted review would produce verified change requests and a candidate stabilization route, not implementation changes, semantic promotion, production readiness, publication, release, or deployment.
